parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ input: 'Find 5 systematic intraday futures trading strategies (ES, NQ, or CL) with documented entry rules, exit rules, walk-forward results, and Sharpe > 1.5. Source from arxiv, ssrn, quantpedia, robotwealth, quantitativo. Strategies must be implementable with one of these indicators: sma_crossover, ema_crossover, rsi_reversal, bollinger_breakout, atr_breakout, vwap_reversion, donchian_breakout, keltner_squeeze, session_open_breakout, macd_crossover.', processor: 'core', task_spec: { output_schema: { type: 'json', json_schema: { type: 'object', properties: { strategies: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { name: { type: 'string' }, description: { type: 'string' }, symbol: { type: 'string', enum: ['MES','MNQ','MCL'] }, timeframe: { type: 'string' }, direction: { type: 'string', enum: ['long','short','both'] }, entry_type: { type: 'string' }, entry_indicator: { type: 'string' }, entry_params: { type: 'string', description: 'JSON-stringified or natural-language description of entry parameters' }, entry_condition: { type: 'string' }, exit_type: { type: 'string' }, exit_params: { type: 'string', description: 'JSON-stringified or natural-language description of exit parameters' }, stop_loss_atr_multiple: { type: 'number' }, take_profit_atr_multiple: { type: 'number' }, source_url: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['name','description','symbol','timeframe','direction','entry_type','entry_indicator','entry_params','entry_condition','exit_type','exit_params','stop_loss_atr_multiple'] } } }, required: ['strategies'] } } }, source_policy: { include_domains: ['arxiv.org','ssrn.com','quantpedia.com','robotwealth.com','quantitativo.com','papers.ssrn.com','papers.nber.org','quantocracy.com','quant.stackexchange.com'], after_date: new Date(Date.now() - 365 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10) } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ ideas: [{ thesis: $json.description, market: $json.symbol === 'MES' ? 'ES' : ($json.symbol === 'MNQ' ? 'NQ' : 'CL'), timeframe: $json.timeframe, entry_rules: $json.entry_condition + ' (indicator: ' + $json.entry_indicator + ')', exit_rules: 'Exit type: ' + $json.exit_type + '. Stop: ' + $json.stop_loss_atr_multiple + ' ATR. Target: ' + ($json.take_profit_atr_multiple || 'trailing'), risk_rules: 'ATR-based stop at ' + $json.stop_loss_atr_multiple + 'x ATR; max contracts per ATR scaling.', source_url: $json.source_url || 'https://parallel.ai/research', regime: 'TRENDING_UP', concept_name: $json.entry_indicator, source_provider: 'parallel', signal_type: 'strategy_candidate' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: 'alerts', event: 'strategy:find', payload: { thesis: $json.description, market: $json.symbol === 'MES' ? 'ES' : ($json.symbol === 'MNQ' ? 'NQ' : 'CL'), timeframe: $json.timeframe, entryRules: $json.entry_condition, exitRules: 'exit_type: ' + $json.exit_type, riskRules: 'stop ' + $json.stop_loss_atr_multiple + ' ATR', sourceUrl: $json.source_url || 'https://parallel.ai/research', regime: 'TRENDING_UP', crossValStatus: 'pending' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: 'alerts', event: 'workflow:error', payload: { workflowId: '5K-parallel-deep-research', workflowName: '5K Parallel Deep Research', executionId: $execution.id, nodeName: 'unknown', errorMessage: ($json.error?.message || 'unknown error').slice(0, 500), firstSeenAt: new Date().toISOString(), occurrenceCount: 1 } }) }}
